title: Meet the Switch Family
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning electronics and switch selection
description: An interactive five-column infographic comparing tactile push buttons, toggle switches, slide switches, rocker switches, and DIP switches.

learningObjectives: Explain how physical form, switching behavior, and contact arrangement make each common switch type suitable for different uses.

keyQuestions: Which switches are momentary and which are latching?
How does a switch's physical form make it better for a particular use?
commonMisconceptions: A four-pin tactile button has four independent contacts.
The physical switch style alone determines whether its contacts are SPST or SPDT.
